messages:
incident-bot: PD ALERT: high error-rate (5xx) on inference-gateway-usw2 — 5m avg 4.7% > threshold 3%. Alert: PD#P12345. routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. tagging @erin (oncall).
incident-bot: Signals: increased upstream 502/504 from model-worker-small pool, p95 latency steady, request rate +26% vs baseline. Dashboard: https://redwood.metrics/incidents/1798881234
erin (oncall): Acked in PD. I'm on it — checking dashboards + recent deploys. :eyes:
sam (eng-sre): Not seeing any deploys in last hour. Mesh shows retries spiking and many `connection reset` from model-worker-small. Possible saturation/FD leak on that pool.
maya (eng-runtime): grabbing logs now. snippet from model-worker stderr:
```
2026-03-17T21:33:41Z ERROR connection reset by peer while reading response
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/worker/serve.py", line 412, in handle_request
    resp = model.infer(req)
OSError: read failed
```
maya (eng-runtime): Also seeing frequent gRPC deadline_exceeded when forwarding to local kv-cache on small instances.
erin (oncall): OK. Immediate mitigation: can we shift traffic off `model-pool-small` to `model-pool-medium` and scale medium by +3? I'll trigger traffic weight change.
sam (eng-sre): Running a soft restart of small workers and draining unhealthy pods. Command I'm running: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-worker -n prod -l pool=small` — will also `kubectl cordon` the worst hosts.
alex (support): Drafting status update for status.redwood.com — will note partial errors on generation and embeddings in US-WEST with mitigation in progress. pinging CSMs for known enterprise customers.
erin (oncall): Applying temporary routing override now: `curl -X POST https://config.redwood/api/v1/route/weights -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","pool_weights":{"model-pool-medium":0.8,"model-pool-small":0.2}}'` — will watch.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident P12345 acknowledged by erin (oncall).
maya (eng-runtime): After reroute + drain we see 5xx drop: 4.7% -> 1.2% in ~4m. p95 latency for generate still fine. :thumbsup:
sam (eng-sre): Restarted 6 pods, draining 4 nodes. I'm collecting `tcpdump` and model-worker logs to confirm connection resets coincide with node churn.
erin (oncall): Leaving page open for 30m. Who takes postmortem? @sam can you own? I'll collate timeline for support notes.
sam (eng-sre): I will own the postmortem. Will include heap/fd stats, routing change deltas, and autoscale history.
alex (support): We'll run customer outreach morning CET and include workaround (retry with exponential backoff) in the support KB. Notifying impacted customers now. :email:
maya (eng-runtime): Filing an action item: increase probe frequency and add connection-reuse metrics for small pool — assigning to runtime team.
erin (oncall): Thanks all. If error-rate stays <=1.5% for 30m we'll demote to monitoring and close PD. Keep updates in this thread.
incident-bot: Auto-check-in scheduled in 10m. Will post metrics snapshot then.
pd-bot: PD: Will resolve P12345 when incident is closed by erin (oncall).
